headline: Revenue accelerates but a legal charge dents net income
summary_short: Equifax's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 3.1% q/q and 10.6% y/y to $1.700B, but net income fell 3.9% y/y to $183.9M after a $40.0M net legal-settlement charge, while diluted EPS still edged up 0.7% y/y to $1.54 on a smaller share count.
summary_long: Revenue grew 10.6% y/y to $1.700B on strong Workforce Solutions, USIS (+17%, Mortgage +40%), and International growth. Operating margin compressed 174bps y/y to 18.5% as a $40.0M net accrual for a legal settlement tied to a prior coding issue, plus antitrust costs, weighed on results. Net income fell 3.9% y/y to $183.9M, but diluted EPS still rose 0.7% y/y to $1.54 as diluted shares fell to 119.2M from 125.0M on buybacks ($300M in Q2). Cash fell 10.0% y/y to $170.1M as buybacks and debt repayment outpaced operating cash flow. Guides Q3 revenue to $1.680-1.710B and FY2026 revenue to $6.710-6.780B, with FY2026 adjusted EPS of $8.39-$8.69.

Management highlighted a 16% new-product Vitality Index, doubled the 2026-2028 AI-driven cost-reduction target to $150 million, and signed a $750 million deal to acquire Mexican credit bureau Círculo de Crédito, expected to close in Q4 2026.
